{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - << 'EOF'
src = open('tinydb/journal.py').read()
old = """        # --- Validate the batch itself -------------------------------------
        if not isinstance(operations, (list, tuple)):
            raise ValueError('operations must be a list of operation dicts')"""
new = """        # --- Validate the batch itself -------------------------------------
        # Accept any iterable of operation dicts (a list is expected).
        try:
            ops = list(operations)
        except TypeError:
            raise ValueError(
                f'operations must be an iterable of operation dicts: '
                f'{operations!r}'
            ) from None"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
old2 = "            for op in operations:"
new2 = "            for op in ops:"
assert old2 in src
src = src.replace(old2, new2)
open('tinydb/journal.py','w').write(src)
print('patched')
EOF
git status --short; echo ===; python -m pytest -o addopts= -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
